GitHub REST and GraphQL enforce SEPARATE rate-limit pools, and the GitHub MCP mixes them within one PR flow: merge_pull_request is REST, while update_pull_request(draft:false) is GraphQL-only (markPullRequestReadyForReview — GitHub exposes no REST equivalent). Proven 2026-08-01 on PR #187: the merge call returned a clean 405 'still a draft' while the un-draft call returned 'rate limit already exceeded for user ID 108373010'. Consequences: (1) a GraphQL strike does NOT block merging an already-non-draft PR; (2) un-draft as soon as CI is green rather than at merge time; (3) when a session is GraphQL-blocked on a green PR, the owner clicking 'Ready for review' alone unblocks it — no need to wait out the rolling hour.
